sources.sentence: A larger firm may offer graduates a steadier runway.

brief.meaningEn: A more stable period or basis of support for getting started and building momentum.
brief.meaningZh: 起步及逐漸發展時，有較穩定的一段支援或基礎。
brief.grammar: offer/give someone a steadier runway; comparative creative launch metaphor, not a fixed employment benefit.
brief.register: Explanatory metaphor in career or project discussion.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是實際機場跑道，也不自動指創業資金可用多久；本課須說清支援內容。
brief.misconceptionZh: 穩定起步不保證升職或無風險；比較應有明確的訓練、時間或指導依據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能按實際支援比較起步條件，不只憑機構大小推斷。

listening.promptZh: runway 比喻在這裏指甚麼？

options.en: Support that made the early learning period more stable.
options.zh: 令初期學習較穩定的支援。

options.en: An expectation that starters learn everything without guidance.
options.zh: 要求新人沒有指導也學會一切。

options.en: A completed promotion before the placement began.
options.zh: 實習開始前已完成的升職。

options.en: A shorter learning period with no time set aside for practice.
options.zh: 較短學習期，沒有預留練習時間。

listening.explanationZh: 導師及預留時間是具體起步支援，比喻不是升職保證。
listening.en: The placement offered a steadier runway than working alone: new starters had a mentor and protected time to learn the basic tasks.
listening.zh: 比獨自開始工作，實習提供較穩定的起步支援：新人有導師及專門預留的時間學基本任務。

reply.promptEn: Why might this placement be helpful for someone starting out?
reply.promptZh: 這個實習為甚麼可能幫到剛起步的人？

options.en: A mentor is available while they learn unfamiliar tasks.
options.zh: 他們學陌生任務時，有導師可以請教。

options.en: It offers a steadier runway through planned training and regular support.
options.zh: 有計劃的培訓及定期支援，讓它提供更穩定的起步基礎。

options.en: The first month includes time to practise before taking on more responsibility.
options.zh: 首月有時間先練習，再承擔更多責任。

options.en: The team checks progress rather than leaving beginners to guess.
options.zh: 小組會檢視進展，而非讓初學者自行猜測。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均點名初期支援；金句不是只因規模大便說穩定。

scene.promptZh: 兩個義工計劃中，一個初期有導師、每週檢討及循序練習，另一個讓新人立即獨立處理。哪句描述前者較準確？

options.en: It gives newcomers a steadier runway.
options.zh: 它給新人更穩定的起步支援。

options.en: It expects newcomers to manage everything alone from the first day.
options.zh: 它要求新人首日就獨自處理全部。

options.en: It provides only a final assessment, with no practice beforehand.
options.zh: 它只提供最後評估，事前沒有練習。

scene.explanationZh: 導師、每週檢討及循序練習支持較穩定起步，並非首日獨自做或只在最後評估。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜單憑 a steadier runway 得出？

options.en: There is a more stable basis for beginning.
options.zh: 開始時有較穩定基礎。

options.en: Success and promotion are guaranteed without further work.
options.zh: 不用繼續投入也保證成功及升職。

options.en: Support may allow time to build useful skills.
options.zh: 支援可能提供時間培養有用技能。

contrast.explanationZh: 起步支援提供機會，不等於自動成功或晉升。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「公司大，就不用問新人怎樣受訓吧？」哪句較準確？

options.en: A steadier runway depends on the support offered, so I would ask about the mentor and training time.
options.zh: 起步支援較穩定取決於實際安排，所以我會問導師及培訓時間。

options.en: Compare only the number of branches when choosing where to begin.
options.zh: 選在哪裏起步時，只比較分店數目。

options.en: Accept the role before checking whether the advertised training has time allocated to it.
options.zh: 未查宣傳的培訓有沒有預留時間，就接受職位。

dialogue.explanationZh: 應查實際初期安排，而非只看規模或未核對培訓便下結論。

speaking.en: The mentor and training time give beginners a steadier runway.
speaking.zh: 導師及培訓時間給初學者更穩定的起步支援。
speaking.promptZh: 你想用具體安排解釋較穩定起步。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你選擇第一個工作坊助教計劃，看到其中一個有觀課、導師及逐步試教，想了解支援是否落實。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The observation sessions and mentor could give me a steadier runway. I would like to confirm how much supervised practice is included.
examples.zh: 觀課及導師可能給我更穩定的起步支援。我想確認有多少受指導練習。

examples.en: This programme seems to offer a steadier runway through gradual teaching practice, but I should check the actual schedule.
examples.zh: 這個計劃透過循序試教，似乎提供較穩定的起步支援，但我應查實際時間表。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以觀課、導師或循序試教支持比較，保留 could 或 seems 及核對安排，不單看機構大小。

takeaways.en: Structured support can offer new starters a steadier runway.
takeaways.zh: 有結構的支援可給新人更穩定的起步基礎。

takeaways.en: A steadier runway gives us time to learn, not a guarantee of success.
takeaways.zh: 更穩定的起步支援給我們學習時間，不是成功保證。

sources.sentence: The effects of the closure could ripple out across the region.

sources.sentence: A job change may ripple through the whole family.

brief.meaningEn: Spread from an initial event or group to affect other people or areas.
brief.meaningZh: 從最初事件或群體向外擴散，影響其他人或領域。
brief.grammar: Effects, benefits or problems can ripple out or ripple outward from a starting point; a change can also ripple through a family when linked relatives are affected. Identify the initial cause and transmission, rather than assuming coincidence proves impact.
brief.register: Common figurative water-movement phrasal verb; can describe good or bad effects.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示每個人同時受相同影響，也不限定一定緩慢；需有傳播連結。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要說明最初來源及後續影響，不能只把同時發生但無關的事連起來。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描繪有依據的連鎖影響，並保留範圍差異。

options.en: A change at the library affected activity at a nearby business.
options.zh: 圖書館的改變影響附近店舖的活動。

options.en: The café’s earlier closure caused the library to reduce its hours.
options.zh: 咖啡店提早關門，令圖書館縮短時間。

options.en: The longer hours affected only the librarian’s desk arrangement.
options.zh: 延長時間只影響圖書館員的桌面安排。

options.en: The café’s customers changed independently of the study sessions.
options.zh: 咖啡店顧客的變化與溫習時段無關。

listening.explanationZh: 晚間圖書館使用增加，帶動之後到咖啡店的人流，是具體連結；不是反向因果或無關同時發生。
listening.en: The library’s longer opening hours rippled out to the nearby café, which began serving more students after evening study sessions.
listening.zh: 圖書館延長開放的影響擴散到附近咖啡店；晚間溫習後到店的學生增加。

reply.promptEn: How could the new repair classes benefit people beyond those who attend?
reply.promptZh: 新維修班可怎樣幫到直接參加者以外的人？

options.en: Participants might show family members how to fix small items.
options.zh: 參加者可能教家人修小物品。

options.en: The benefits could ripple out as learners share what they have practised.
options.zh: 學習者分享練過的技巧時，好處可能向外擴散。

options.en: Neighbours could borrow tools and learn from someone who took the class.
options.zh: 鄰居可向上過課的人借工具並請教。

options.en: Families could spend less on replacements when learners repair household items.
options.zh: 學員修理家居物品時，家人可減少花錢更換。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均提出直接學員以外的可能好處；金句保留 could，不保證所有人都受惠。

scene.promptZh: 一位同學學會查證消息，之後教家人，再由家人向同事分享方法。哪句合適？

options.en: The learning ripples out through their connections.
options.zh: 學習透過人際連結向外擴散。

options.en: The learning stays with the first student and is never shared.
options.zh: 學習只留在首名學生身上，從未分享。

options.en: The colleagues learnt the method independently, without hearing it from the student or family.
options.zh: 同事獨立學會方法，沒有從學生或家人聽過。

scene.explanationZh: 方法由學生到家人再到同事，有分享連結，不是留在起點或各自獨立學會。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜單憑 ripple out 作出？

options.en: An effect can reach beyond its starting point.
options.zh: 影響可超出最初起點。

options.en: Connections can transmit an effect to other groups.
options.zh: 連結可把影響傳到其他群體。

options.en: Every person must experience the same effect at the same time.
options.zh: 每個人必須在同一時間有相同影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 擴散範圍、時間及效果可不同，沒有全體同時一致的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「兩間店同日生意變了，就是同一影響擴散吧？」哪句較準確？

options.en: Effects can ripple out, but we should check what connects the changes before claiming a link.
options.zh: 影響可以向外擴散，但說有連結前，應查甚麼把變化連起來。

options.en: Use the matching dates as enough evidence without checking customer patterns.
options.zh: 只因日期相同就當證據足夠，不查顧客模式。

options.en: Describe one shop’s change as the cause before asking whether the shops share customers.
options.zh: 未問兩店是否有共同顧客，就說一店改變是另一店的成因。

dialogue.explanationZh: 同時發生不等於因果，要查顧客或其他實際連結。

speaking.en: The benefits can ripple out when participants share their new skills.
speaking.zh: 參加者分享新技能時，好處可向外擴散。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述分享帶來的間接好處。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生學會節約食物，回家和家人分享，家人再把做法帶到工作場所。用一至兩句英文描述影響怎樣擴散。

examples.en: The lessons can ripple out as students share food-saving ideas with their families. Family members may then try them at work.
examples.zh: 學生與家人分享節約食物想法時，課堂影響可向外擴散。家人之後可能在工作場所嘗試。

examples.en: The benefits ripple out through family conversations and workplace habits, rather than staying only in the classroom.
examples.zh: 好處透過家庭談話及工作習慣向外擴散，而非只留在課室。

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出由學生到家人再到工作場所的傳播連結；可用 can 或 may 保留未必人人實行。

takeaways.en: A small change can ripple out through a connected community.
takeaways.zh: 小改變可透過互相連結的社區向外擴散。

sources.sentence: A tiny fine may not make a dent in the firm's profits.

brief.meaningEn: Reduce an amount or make noticeable progress against a larger problem, without necessarily removing it completely.
brief.meaningZh: 令數量有所減少，或對較大的問題取得明顯進展，但不一定完全解決。
brief.grammar: make a dent in + backlog/debt/profits/problem; not make much of a dent is also possible.
brief.register: Common impact metaphor; a reduction can be welcome or unwelcome depending on what is reduced.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是一定完全清零，也不一定是好事；利潤受損和積壓減少的評價不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要看被減少的是甚麼，以及數量相對大小，不能把小變化當成全解決。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述有界線的減少或進展，並指出仍有工作。

listening.promptZh: 額外義工帶來甚麼結果？

options.en: They reduced the outstanding work without clearing it all.
options.zh: 他們減少了未完成工作，但未全部清掉。

options.en: They finished every box and left nothing outstanding.
options.zh: 他們完成每箱，沒有留下任何工作。

options.en: They added new boxes without sorting any records.
options.zh: 他們只加新箱，沒有整理任何紀錄。

options.en: They counted the boxes but made no progress on the records.
options.zh: 他們只數箱子，沒有推進紀錄工作。

listening.explanationZh: but still needed 指仍有剩餘；made a dent 表示已減少，不是全清或完全沒進展。
listening.en: The extra volunteers made a dent in the backlog, but several boxes of records still needed sorting.
listening.zh: 額外義工讓積壓工作明顯減少，但仍有幾箱紀錄要整理。

reply.promptEn: Did the extra sorting session help with the backlog?
reply.promptZh: 額外整理時段有幫減少積壓嗎？

options.en: Yes, we cleared several boxes that had been waiting for weeks.
options.zh: 有，我們清掉幾箱已積了幾星期的工作。

options.en: Yes, it made a dent in the backlog, though there is more to do.
options.zh: 有，它讓積壓工作減少，但仍有更多要做。

options.en: We finished the older records and can now focus on the recent ones.
options.zh: 我們完成較舊紀錄，現在可以專注較新的。

options.en: The remaining pile is smaller after everyone worked together.
options.zh: 大家合作後，剩下那堆減少了。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理回答整理的實際進展；金句明確保留未完成部分。

scene.promptZh: 二百份待處理表格中，你們今天完成了四十份，其餘仍需核對。哪句合適？

options.en: Today’s work made a dent in the backlog.
options.zh: 今天的工作讓積壓明顯減少。

options.en: Today’s work cleared every outstanding form.
options.zh: 今天的工作清掉所有未完成表格。

options.en: The remaining workload is unchanged because no forms were processed.
options.zh: 因為沒處理任何表格，剩餘工作量沒有改變。

scene.explanationZh: 四十份是實際進展，但二百份未全部完成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 make a dent in the backlog 得出？

options.en: Some outstanding work has been removed.
options.zh: 部分未完成工作已減少。

options.en: The whole backlog is necessarily gone.
options.zh: 全部積壓工作必定清掉。

options.en: There may still be substantial work remaining.
options.zh: 仍可能有不少工作剩下。

contrast.explanationZh: dent 表示一定程度影響，不等於完全消除。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「今天完成一些了，就取消下一次整理吧？」哪句較有幫助？

options.en: We have made a dent in the backlog, but let us check what remains before changing the plan.
options.zh: 我們已讓積壓減少，但改計劃前先查還剩甚麼。

options.en: Cancel the next session on the basis of today’s completed pile alone.
options.zh: 只看今天完成那堆，就取消下次時段。

options.en: Count only how many volunteers came, rather than how much work is still waiting.
options.zh: 只數來了多少義工，不查還有多少工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 肯定進展，也核對剩餘工作；完成一部分或人數並不足以決定取消安排。

speaking.en: The extra help made a dent in the backlog, but we still have work to do.
speaking.zh: 額外幫忙讓積壓工作減少，但我們仍有工作要做。
speaking.promptZh: 你想報告有進展而未全部完成。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們整理社團相片，今天標好了一大批，但還有三個相簿未處理。用一至兩句英文說明進展及下一步。

examples.en: Today’s labelling made a dent in the backlog. We still need to organise the last three albums.
examples.zh: 今天加標籤讓積壓工作明顯減少。我們仍要整理最後三個相簿。

examples.en: The group made a dent in the pile of unlabelled photos, but another session is needed for the remaining albums.
examples.zh: 小組讓未加標籤的照片減少，但剩下的相簿還要再安排一次時段。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出標籤工作帶來減少，也清楚交代未完成相簿；不把有進展誇成全部完成。

takeaways.en: The first session made a dent in the backlog without clearing it completely.
takeaways.zh: 首個時段讓積壓減少，但未完全清掉。

takeaways.en: The unexpected cost made a dent in the project’s budget.
takeaways.zh: 意外費用耗去了項目一部分預算。

sources.sentence: The small penalty felt like a slap on the wrist.

brief.meaningEn: A mild punishment, often viewed as too lenient for the wrongdoing.
brief.meaningZh: 輕微處罰，常帶有相對過失而言太寬鬆的評價。
brief.grammar: a slap on the wrist; get/receive a slap on the wrist; figurative punishment, not literal hitting.
brief.register: Informal and often critical; explain what makes the consequence seem insufficient.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是鼓勵體罰，也不代表每次警告都不恰當；是否太輕須看情境。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要比較過失、影響及處分，不能只因自己不滿就斷言必須更重。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認處罰過輕的評價，並以具體影響說明。

listening.promptZh: 那幾名成員怎樣看處分？

options.en: They considered it mild compared with the repeated damage.
options.zh: 他們認為相對反覆損壞，處分太輕。

options.en: They described a severe ban that removed the person from the club.
options.zh: 他們描述把人逐出社團的嚴厲禁令。

options.en: They said the equipment had never been damaged.
options.zh: 他們說器材從未損壞。

options.en: They believed the warning included full repayment of all costs.
options.zh: 他們相信警告包括全額償付所有費用。

listening.explanationZh: only a brief warning 及反覆損壞支持過輕的評價；沒有說逐出或全額償付。
listening.en: After repeated damage to shared equipment, the club gave only a brief warning; several members called it a slap on the wrist.
listening.zh: 有人反覆損壞共用器材，社團卻只簡短警告；幾名成員認為處罰太輕。

reply.promptEn: Why are members unhappy with the response to the repeated equipment damage?
reply.promptZh: 成員為甚麼不滿對反覆損壞器材的處理？

options.en: They think a brief warning does not address the ongoing problem.
options.zh: 他們認為簡短警告沒有處理持續問題。

options.en: They see it as a slap on the wrist after several earlier incidents.
options.zh: 之前已發生幾次，他們覺得這次處罰太輕。

options.en: The damaged items still need repair and the pattern has not changed.
options.zh: 受損物品仍要修理，行為模式也沒改。

options.en: They want the club to explain how the equipment will be protected next time.
options.zh: 他們想社團解釋下次怎樣保護器材。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋不滿的依據；金句是成員對輕微處分的評價，不是實際打人。

scene.promptZh: 屢次破壞公用材料的人只被要求口頭說句對不起，受影響成員認為不足以回應多次損失。哪句符合他們的看法？

options.en: They regarded the consequence as a slap on the wrist.
options.zh: 他們認為後果只是過輕的處罰。

options.en: They regarded the consequence as much harsher than the damage justified.
options.zh: 他們認為後果遠比損失所應有的嚴厲。

options.en: They thought there had been no damage requiring a response.
options.zh: 他們認為根本沒有損壞需要處理。

scene.explanationZh: 多次損失卻只有口頭道歉，配合成員認為不足的評價。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜只憑 a slap on the wrist 得出？

options.en: The punishment is mild.
options.zh: 處罰輕微。

options.en: The speaker may think the consequence was too lenient.
options.zh: 說話者可能認為後果太寬鬆。

options.en: A person was necessarily struck on the arm.
options.zh: 必定有人手臂遭到擊打。

contrast.explanationZh: 本課是處分輕微的慣用比喻，不表示實際體罰。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友認為處分像輕輕警告，但你還未知道過失詳情，該怎樣回應？

options.en: It may seem like a slap on the wrist, but let us check the harm and the full response before judging it.
options.zh: 它可能看來只是輕微處罰，但判斷前先查影響及完整處理。

options.en: Call for a longer ban immediately without asking what happened.
options.zh: 不問發生甚麼，就立即要求更長禁令。

options.en: Compare only the wording of the warning, leaving out the damage and any other consequences.
options.zh: 只比較警告措辭，不看損失及其他後果。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有依據評估過失與全部後果，避免只憑措辭或不完整資料要求更重處分。

speaking.en: They called the warning a slap on the wrist because the damage had happened repeatedly.
speaking.zh: 因為損壞反覆發生，他們認為那個警告處罰太輕。
speaking.promptZh: 你想用具體反覆問題支持過輕評價。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：有人多次不歸還共用工具，影響其他人的工作，最後只收到一個簡短提醒。用一至兩句英文描述成員認為處理太輕，並提出查清全部後果。

examples.en: Some members saw the reminder as a slap on the wrist because the borrower kept failing to return the tools. We should check the full response before judging it.
examples.zh: 因為借用者反覆不歸還工具，一些成員認為提醒處罰太輕。我們應查清完整處理再判斷。

examples.en: It seemed like a slap on the wrist to those whose work was delayed, though we still need to know whether other consequences were agreed.
examples.zh: 對工作被耽誤的人而言，它看來處罰太輕，但我們仍要了解是否另有議定後果。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把評價歸於受影響成員，用反覆不還工具支持，同時容許完整資訊改變判斷。

takeaways.en: A brief warning felt like a slap on the wrist after the repeated breaches.
takeaways.zh: 反覆違規後，簡短警告感覺處罰太輕。

takeaways.en: Before calling it a slap on the wrist, we should understand the full consequences.
takeaways.zh: 說它處罰太輕前，我們應了解全部後果。

sources.sentence: The fine should not become a cost of doing business.

brief.meaningEn: An expense treated as a routine part of operating; in criticism, a penalty that an organisation absorbs instead of changing its conduct.
brief.meaningZh: 被當作經營中的常規開支；批評語境中，可指機構寧願付出而不改行為的罰款。
brief.grammar: a/the cost of doing business; count something as a cost of doing business.
brief.register: Conventional business phrase; context distinguishes normal operating expenses from criticism of treating wrongdoing as affordable.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說所有成本都不值得減少，也不是替違規辯護；本課批評罰款未帶來改變。
brief.misconceptionZh: 被視為成本是行為人的態度，不等於該做法合理或社會應接受。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋常規開支的概念，並理解把罰款當成本的批評。

options.en: The company absorbed the penalty instead of changing its conduct.
options.zh: 公司承擔罰款，卻不改變行為。

options.en: The company stopped the practice and prevented further harm.
options.zh: 公司停止該做法，避免進一步傷害。

options.en: The penalty had made the practice too costly to continue.
options.zh: 罰款已令該做法成本高到不能繼續。

options.en: The company used the payment to fund a new staff-training programme.
options.zh: 公司把款項用於資助新的員工培訓。

listening.explanationZh: continued the same harmful practice 顯示罰款被當作開支吸收，沒有促成改變；不是停用流程或拿去資助培訓。
listening.en: The penalty was so small that the company treated it as a cost of doing business and continued the same harmful practice.
listening.zh: 罰款太小，公司把它當成營運常規成本，繼續同樣有害做法。

reply.promptEn: Why do critics think the small penalty has not changed the company’s behaviour?
reply.promptZh: 批評者為甚麼認為小額罰款未改變公司行為？

options.en: The company can absorb the payment and keep using the same process.
options.zh: 公司可承擔款項，繼續用同樣流程。

options.en: It seems to count the fine as a cost of doing business rather than a reason to change.
options.zh: 它似乎把罰款當營運成本，而非改變的理由。

options.en: The harmful practice has continued after several payments.
options.zh: 已付過幾次款項，有害做法仍持續。

options.en: The amount has not made the current approach less attractive to the company.
options.zh: 金額未令公司覺得目前做法較不划算。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均解釋罰款未改變誘因或行為；金句描述並批評機構態度，而非認同行為。

scene.promptZh: 工廠把反覆違規的小額罰款列入每月開支，沒有修改出問題流程。哪句符合這種批評？

options.en: The fines have become a cost of doing business for the factory.
options.zh: 對工廠而言，罰款已變成營運常規成本。

options.en: The fines have led the factory to replace the harmful process.
options.zh: 罰款已令工廠更換有害流程。

options.en: The factory has stopped budgeting for any recurring expense.
options.zh: 工廠已停止為任何經常開支作預算。

scene.explanationZh: 把罰款列作常規開支而不改流程，是這裏的批評重點。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 calls it a cost of doing business 得出？

options.en: The organisation treats the payment as part of its operating expenses.
options.zh: 機構把款項當成經營開支。

options.en: The behaviour causing the payment is therefore acceptable and should not be questioned.
options.zh: 引致款項的行為因此合理，不應受質疑。

options.en: The phrase can be used critically when a penalty fails to change conduct.
options.zh: 罰款未改變行為時，可以批評地使用這個片語。

contrast.explanationZh: 描述成本分類不等於認可導致成本的行為；要看付款原因及影響。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「既然公司付得起罰款，就不用再處理造成的傷害吧？」哪句較準確？

options.en: Treating the fine as a cost of doing business does not address the harm; we should examine what changes have actually been made.
options.zh: 把罰款當營運成本，沒有處理傷害；我們應了解實際作了甚麼改變。

options.en: Compare the fine with the budget and stop there without checking the affected people’s experience.
options.zh: 只把罰款與預算比較，不再查看受影響者的經驗。

options.en: Report that the issue is resolved once the payment clears, before checking the process.
options.zh: 款項一付妥，未查流程便報告問題已解決。

dialogue.explanationZh: 是否付得起與是否處理傷害不同，須查實際行為及影響，而非只看付款。

speaking.en: A fine should not become merely a cost of doing business while the harmful practice continues.
speaking.zh: 有害做法仍持續時，罰款不應只變成營運常規成本。
speaking.promptZh: 你想表達罰款需要促成實際改變。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一間機構屢次弄壞共用場地設備，每次只付小額補償，仍沒有改善搬運流程。用一至兩句英文描述這種態度，並要求了解實際改變。

examples.en: The organisation seems to treat the payments as a cost of doing business. We should ask how it will improve the handling process.
examples.zh: 機構似乎把付款當營運常規成本。我們應問它會怎樣改善搬運流程。

examples.en: Repeated compensation has become a cost of doing business rather than a reason to change. The equipment needs better protection.
examples.zh: 反覆補償已變成營運常規成本，而非改變的理由。設備需要更好的保護。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出反覆付款卻未改流程，描述態度不等於接受它；要求具體改善及保護設備。

takeaways.en: The company counted maintenance as a normal cost of doing business.
takeaways.zh: 公司把保養列為正常營運成本。

takeaways.en: Calling a fine a cost of doing business does not make the underlying conduct acceptable.
takeaways.zh: 把罰款稱為營運成本，不會令背後行為變得合理。
